data_fields.name: party_max_size
data_fields.donor_constant: maxSize passed by the creator (value not read); cap counts members plus held seats

data_fields.name: seat_hold_timeout
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (no timeout visible in Accept)

best_idea: Hold a seat for a pending join while it is confirmed elsewhere, so the cap counts it and a failed confirm gives it back; a batch join is all-or-nothing against the cap.
decision_why: The seat hold across an async confirm, the all-or-nothing batch check and oldest-member succession are simple, testable server rules. Reject the lock-free read snapshot unless Frankendom's server is multi-threaded, and add a hold timeout the donor does not have.
acceptance: A server test with max 3: an accept whose stream confirm fails leaves the roster at its old size and frees the seat, so the next accepted request still succeeds; a fourth accept while three members are present returns full.
